configuration.name: Seated extended-leg wave
configuration.contact_model: Reuse the measured Sit contact path. While seated, three soles remain fixed; the extended front-left foot is airborne. Retrace the same arm and Sit paths to return.
configuration.completion: Lower the waving foot into Sit, then return to standing and hold; restore the stand face.
configuration.reach_basis: Use the existing research carrier/crank endpoints; do not solve for a straight or maximally stretched linkage. These endpoints are not calibrated hardware stops.

metadata.world_axes: X forward, Y left, Z up; negative body Y pitch lifts the front.
